<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-08-2003-45-33" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bod bsgres pa rnams</rs> na de spyir sher phyin la 2 snying po don gyi ger myin dang mngon rtogs kyi sher bhyin no ||dang po ni ko1 gi ka sre bde ye bde kyang du rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa tshul bya snga bcu pa nar snying

lasogs pa'o | mngon rtogs kyi shar phyin ni 'bum nas sdud pa'i bar mngon rtogs byad du phye nas bstan pa'o || </seg></TEI>
